messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the INC-2026-411 postmortem. I collected the open actions into one epic so we can run a closure dry-run before marking the postmortem done: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9901. Please claim items + add ETA + attach your subtask.

Sam: Short checklist we need to cover in the dry-run:
- action owners confirmed + owner-of-record on each ticket
- RACI documented in ticket description
- rollback playbook updated and linked
- verification SOP & smoke test added to CI
- one biweekly checkpoint added to epic until two clean releases

Priya: I'll take the rollback playbook update and the communication template for Support/PM. ETA: 4 business days. Will add RI-9902 and link.

Leo: I'll own the verification SOP and add the smoke test job in CI. ETA: 3 days. I'll make RI-9903 and include a small load script snippet.

marie: I'll run the owner-of-record audit across the system and make sure all subtasks have RACI. Creating RI-9904 now. ETA: EOD Tue.

devops-bot: Created JIRA RI-9902 "Rollback playbook + comms template" assigned to Priya. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9902

devops-bot: Created JIRA RI-9903 "Verification SOP + CI smoke job" assigned to Leo. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9903

devops-bot: Created JIRA RI-9904 "Owner-of-record audit + RACI enforcement" assigned to marie. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9904

Sam: Two quick asks before we close the dry-run: 1) include a short acceptance criteria field on each subtask (PASS/FAIL with minimal checks), 2) tag any ticket that recommends infra changes with 'capacity-impact' so infra can estimate cost.

Leo: Will add an "acceptance_criteria" section to RI-9903 and a tiny shell snippet for the smoke test:

```
# smoke test loop
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -sS https://staging.redwood/health || exit 1; done
```

Priya: I'll link the rollback comms template to RI-9902 and add a short handoff note for oncall with steps to follow during a rollback dry-run.

marie: Audit pre-check: some subtasks are missing an explicit owner-of-record label. I'll add a note on each ticket and ping the listed assignee to confirm.

Sam: For RACI, my recommendation per item is: R = assignee, A = team lead (or Sam for cross-team), C = SME (tagged in ticket), I = oncall rotation. If you disagree, call it out.

Priya: That mapping makes sense. I'll annotate RI-9902.

Leo: One more: can we run the dry-run in the staging window next Thursday? If yes I'll reserve the CI slot and invite oncall.

Sam: Thursday staging window works for me. I'll schedule and add a calendar invite. Also adding a biweekly checkpoint on RI-9901 until we get two consecutive clean releases.

marie: Dropping a quick note to infra: if the verification SOP suggests scale changes, please attach a cost estimate and tag as 'capacity-impact'. @infra-team FYI.

devops-bot: Epic RI-9901 updated: subtasks RI-9902, RI-9903, RI-9904 linked.

Sam: Great. Drop an emoji when your subtask is linked and you've added acceptance criteria so I can sign off the dry-run plan.

Priya: :heavy_check_mark:

Leo: :white_check_mark:

marie: :thumbsup:
